rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern for movement from outside to the inside of something.

example.english: I stuffed the clothes into the suitcase.
example.traditional: 我將啲衫塞入個喼入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 saam1 sak1 jap6 go3 gip1 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use 變成 when something changes into a different form, substance, or finished result.

example.jyutping: di1 syut3 bin3 sing4 seoi2 laa3

rows.note: Use this everyday pattern to say that someone is interested in or attracted to a subject.

example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 jat6 bun2 coi3 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use 撞到 when something collides with or hits another object, especially forcefully.

example.english: The car crashed into the rubbish bin.
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 zong6 dou2 go3 laap6 saap3 tung2
